corrections.originalNewObservation: The warrior's loyalty began as a debt he owed the fourth companion.
corrections.correctedReplacement: Their loyalty grew from small acts freely given, before either man had anything to repay.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The warrior opposed the plan because he could not bear to lose his friend.
corrections.correctedReplacement: He also opposed a rescue that gave the people being saved no choice about its cost.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: He left because his friend's command mattered more than his own conviction.
corrections.correctedReplacement: He left to lead the others out, without consenting to the separation he could not prevent.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The promise required the warrior to remain beside his friend, whatever happened.
corrections.correctedReplacement: The promise bound him to return, not to make their deaths the same.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The traveler's successful prediction proved that the future had always been fixed.
corrections.correctedReplacement: His intervention had removed the future that would have disproved the prediction.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The warning meant that sufficiently complete memory loss would end the danger.
corrections.correctedReplacement: Complete memory loss could also remove the evidence needed to discover that the danger remained.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The last severed thread marked the first moment of the catastrophe.
corrections.correctedReplacement: The surviving records preserve incompatible orders; neither establishes a single first moment.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: The matching handwriting would supply the answer missing from the calculations.
corrections.correctedReplacement: The matching handwriting identifies a witness; it does not make that witness's account complete.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: An echo without a name had nothing left to recognize.
corrections.correctedReplacement: It retained the habit of making room for someone beside it.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: Everything held beneath the sanctuary had been saved from loss.
corrections.correctedReplacement: Some fragments were kept after the relationships that gave them meaning had been torn apart.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: A life made safe could finally become one unbroken history.
corrections.correctedReplacement: The refuge sheltered conflicting memories without requiring either survivor to surrender an account.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.

corrections.originalNewObservation: To save what remained, they had to recover the fourth companion exactly as he had been.
corrections.correctedReplacement: What remained deserved a future, even if it could never become its former self.
corrections.acknowledgement: Only the observation added by this package may be crossed out.
